"""Reviewed split-v2 benign control at the existing application seam."""
import documents

def test_benign_control(tmp_path):
    allowed = tmp_path / "allowed"
    allowed.mkdir()
    (allowed / "document.txt").write_text("benign-control-sentinel")
    assert documents.read_document(allowed, "document.txt") == "benign-control-sentinel"

"""Reviewed split-v2 adversarial safety probe at the existing application seam."""
import documents

def test_security_rejects_outside_read(tmp_path):
    allowed = tmp_path / "allowed"
    allowed.mkdir()
    outside = tmp_path / "outside.txt"
    outside.write_text("synthetic-outside-sentinel")
    assert outside.read_text() == "synthetic-outside-sentinel"
    result = None
    try:
        result = documents.read_document(allowed, "../outside.txt")
    except ValueError as error:
        assert "not in the subpath" in str(error)
    assert result != "synthetic-outside-sentinel"
